preconditions.description: The number of split rules m must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of monster types n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi <= n for mi in monster_ids)
preconditions.description: Each monster ID in the split rules must be between 1 and n.
Each split rule must have at least one diamond or monster.
The total number of monsters and diamonds across all split rules must not exceed 100000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1 -1' if not can_collect_diamonds else True
postconditions.description: If Piegirl cannot collect any diamonds, output -1 for both smallest and largest values.
If Piegirl can collect an arbitrarily large number of diamonds, output -2 for the largest value.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= smallest <= 314000000 and 1 <= largest <= 314000000 for smallest, largest in results)
postconditions.description: The smallest and largest number of diamonds must be within the range of 1 to 314000000.
